purpose: Resolve remaining bicycle false negatives under class confusion. Use frozen D-FINE outputs from object-centered zooms and a paired rider when available. Infer from RGB only.
selection: Use archive training and development data only. Validate on the original 699 archive frames, Town04 development sites 90 and 608, and Town07 development road 3. Do not use sites 492 or 1576 for calibration.
evaluation: Prepare independent Town07 road 7 without a model, seal the qualified candidate before acquiring its 81 evaluation exposures, and apply the original six-class absolute and YOLOX-S relative criteria. Replay the same candidate on sites 492 and 1576 after freeze.
preparation_after_interruption: After two renderer distance-field failures before qualification, build distance fields and shaders without cameras or inference. Restore original renderer binaries before capture. The interrupted 18 development preparation images are excluded. Shift only the replacement development preparation camera by an additional 5 cm for distinct preparation exposures. Evaluation poses, denominators and gates stay fixed.
development_revision: Town07 development exposed a motorcycle duplicate of a high-confidence parked car on a negative frame. Suppress only a motorcycle whose box overlaps a car scored >=0.90 at IoU >=0.80 with the car ahead by >=0.20. Requalify all development splits before nomination and retain the unmodified parent predictions for comparison.
